spec_case: issue #403: an over-limit CEL condition fails the run, same phase (evaluation, not compile) and the same "maximum recursion depth exceeded" substring on both engines
description: A 239-link index chain over MAX_INDEX_NESTING_DEPTH (238), fed real, resolved data (-e a=<nested list>), fails during evaluation on both engines once the condition actually runs -- not at compile time, and not before the (here, trivially satisfied) unset-path check (issue #403). Circuitry's own text carries a Python-specific, frame-dependent suffix electricity deliberately does not reproduce (DESIGN.md Section 13), so only the shared substring is compared.
